dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline characterized by a significant structural notch/loss of tissue near the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, truncated by a posterior notch.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin measured at approximately 45-50 degrees relative to the dorsal horizontal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.2:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex melon with a consistent, smooth-radius arc terminating at the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak extending from the melon with a low length-to-width pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse angle at the transition point between the descending melon slope and the horizontal rostrum ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped notch on the upper trailing edge of the dorsal fin; multiple light-toned circular and linear scars/lesions visible on the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme high-contrast mottled pigmentation patterns across the dorsal surface, likely exacerbated by surface light refraction.
